summary: Cipher Digital Inc. filed an 8-K furnishing a press release under Item 7.01 and disclosing under Item 8.01 that, on September 24, 2026, its wholly owned subsidiary Cipher Barber Lake LLC amended its Barber Lake data center lease with Fluidstack USA II Inc. and entered a binding commitment with a leading AI lab for a ten-year lease to follow the Fluidstack term. The arrangement extends aggregate contracted term for the Barber Lake Facility to twenty years and is expected to yield approximately $5.2 billion in incremental contracted revenue. Data halls are now expected to be delivered between Q4 2026 and Q1 2027, with rent commencing per hall, the first during Q4 2026; a cost reimbursement framework was also established. This is a routine commercial real estate and lease development update, not a special situation.
